messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — PR #9242 (shardpack allocator tweak) triggered a noticeable mem regression on 4k-longseq canary. p95 resident mem up ~8% (~400MB). bench artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/bench/9242-477900.json

kevin: saw the link, thanks. is that consistent across multiple runs?

maria: yes, 5/5 canary runs. CPU and throughput look stable, but tail mem and OOM risk are up. attaching flamegraph and heapstat in the artifacts.

jess: can you paste the exact command you used to run the bench?

maria: ```
bench run --profile longseq --seq 4096 --repeat 5 --config shardpack-tiling --canary-id canary-4779-9242
```

kevin: can you also paste the small diff that changed reserve behavior? might be obvious.

maria: snippet of the change: 
```diff
-    bucket.reserve(0);
+    bucket.reserve(32); // prefetch bucket items on shard init
```

jess: that reserve makes sense for throughput, but could bloat peak RSS on cold paths. @maria did you try conditional reserve based on shard size?

maria: tried conditional (reserve only if items > 64) — helped p50 a bit but tail still elevated. suspect interaction with KV alignment that keeps pages pinned longer.

kevin: canary-bot, any breakdown of which stage holds the extra mem?

canary-bot: Canary canary-4779-9242 finished. Summary: p95 mem +1.2GiB, p50 +120MB, tail OOMs in 2/5 runs. Latency p95 within noise, throughput -0.3%. Full logs/artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/bench/9242-477900.json :warning:

jess: +1 on reverting if we can't get a quick fix. This is risky for production. @kevin, do you want to approve a revert?

kevin: i'd prefer to see a small follow-up micropatch first. jess, can you try a targeted change to avoid bucket.reserve on hot path and run a 2-run quick bench?

jess: will do. plan: remove reserve, add lazy reserve that grows only after X allocations, push to the branch and re-run the 2-run canary. estimate 30–45m.

maria: thanks. if the micropatch doesn't reduce tail within 2 runs we'll revert. flagging for approvals: if jess's patch looks safe, we can merge under a fast rollback plan.

kevin: sounds good. tagging: @product (fyi) — memory regression risk.

maria: noted. I'll hold merge window and add revert instructions to the PR description.

jess: pushed quick patch to the branch and kicked off the 2-run canary (canary-4779-9242-r2).

canary-bot: Canary canary-4779-9242-r2 completed. Result: p95 mem delta now +140MB vs main, no OOMs in 2 runs. Latency unchanged. Artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/bench/9242-477900-r2.json :white_check_mark:

kevin: nice. that looks acceptable. @maria ok to merge with the micropatch?

maria: ok from my side. i'll give one more hour for additional eyeballs, then merge. thanks y'all. :thumbsup:
